Profile Isepamicin is a semisynthetic aminoglycoside with actions and uses similar to those of gentamicin (p.282). It is reported not to be degraded by many of the enzymes responsible for aminogly- coside resistance. Isepamicin sulfate is given by intramuscular injection or intravenous infusion in a dose of up to 15 mg/kg dai- ly in 2 divided doses. Once-daily dosage may be possible in se- lected patients.
